question: How is the mantra formula constructed and designated with these syllables?
premises: Elements preceded by śrī are uttered
Elements ending with ṅe are uttered
The formula concludes with huṃ phaṭ svāhā
inference: Uttering the śrī-prefixed and ṅe-ending elements followed by huṃ phaṭ svāhā constitutes the named formula.
uncertainties: Exact referents of śrī+pūrvau and ṅe+'ntāv+ are not specified
plain_english: Having uttered the elements preceded by śrī and ending with ṅe, followed by huṃ phaṭ svāhā, it is so called.
